description.p: This is a community package of Bramble Notes, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the Bramble Office project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release (the AppImage) unmodified. Updates come through Flatpak, so the app's own update check is turned off.
Bramble Notes keeps notes with formatting, checklists, tables, drawings, pictures, PDFs and audio, in folders, Smart Folders and tags, with search across them all.
It can import a library from Apple Notes on a Mac, lock notes with a password, and sync between your devices through your own WebDAV storage, such as Nextcloud or Koofr.

Permissions: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback); the GPU device; sound, for audio attachments and Record Audio; network access, for WebDAV sync; and the system print service (saved printer settings in ~/.cups are read, not written). There is no access to your files: Open, Save and Insert go through the system file chooser, and a file opened from the file manager is passed in by it.

Features that run a program the Flatpak runtime doesn't include are unavailable: Fingerprint unlock for locked notes (it runs the host's fprintd tools; the password still works) and previews of PDF pages (they need pdftoppm from Poppler).
